ts.period: Time summary right-click submenu: which period is added up. One word.
ts.today: Period choice: today. Also the start of the tooltip.
ts.all: Category choice: focus and other time together. One word.
ts.tag: Submenu: count only time with this tag. One word.
ts.any_tag: First tag choice: no tag filter. 2 to 3 words.
ts.goal: Submenu: a time goal for the period, shown as a bar. One word.
ts.no_goal: First goal choice: no goal and no bar. 2 words.
ts.hours: A goal in whole hours, {n} is a number. Short.
ts.minutes: A goal under an hour, {n} is minutes. Short.
ts.hm: A goal in hours and minutes. Short.
ts.line: Menu toggle (ticked when on): a thin strip under the number shows when today's time was logged. 2 to 3 words.
ts.of_goal: Tooltip part: progress toward the goal, {p} percent of {goal} (like 3 h).
ts.goal_done: Toast when the counted time reaches the goal while the widget is showing. Short and cheerful.
hint.timesum: Title-bar hint of the time summary widget: what right-click sets. Short, in the 'Action: result' form.
